task_text: Add the smallest synthetic regression in tests/redaction/test_docx_package.py for the previously untested WordprocessingML hidden visibility elements w:vanish and w:webHidden. Prove both synthetic elements are rejected with UnsupportedDocxFeatureError and that no synthetic sensitive value is echoed. Change tests only; preserve every production and safety boundary.
title: cover hidden DOCX visibility elements

command: from pathlib import Path; t=Path('tests/redaction/test_docx_package.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'vanish' in t and 'webHidden' in t and 'UnsupportedDocxFeatureError' in t
